rationale: The agent executed an exchange without confirming order-changing actions, violating the policy requirement to confirm before any write. It directly called exchange_delivered_order_items and then stated the exchange is in process. There is no user confirmation of the selected replacement items, no confirmation of payment method/price difference, and no verification with the user of the order number. While it appears the agent attempted to identify the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip and get_user_details) and looked up some products, there’s no evidence that the coffee machine constraints (8 bar else 9 else 7) were satisfied or that the laptop chosen was the cheapest i7 or above. It also charged a gift card without confirming a price difference existed or obtaining consent. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with the policy.
